name: Kalvin Olafson
bio: Kalvin Olafson grew up on a farm in southern Manitoba and is one of five siblings. When realizing that farming was not the life for him he moved to Vancouver to study and pursue a career in acting. He has since found tremendous success in the commercial world being featured in well over 30 nationals campaigns and has started to gain headway in TV and film with several small roles. Kalvin continues to study acting, and loves the theatre and music as well.

credits.title: Blue Heron
credits.overview: A family of six's fresh start on 1990s Vancouver Island unravels as their youngest child, Sasha, witnesses the increasingly dangerous behavior of her older brother, Jeremy.

credits.title: Ms. Match
credits.overview: Aspiring writer Athena Carter has spent years working as a dating consultant with a less than successful dating history of her own. When her college ex suddenly reemerges, romantic complications ensue as Athena has to figure out who she really is and what she really wants.

credits.title: Star-Crossed Romance
credits.overview: When Denver’s preeminent sportscaster, competitive single-mother Piper, is called to her son’s school for a bullying incident, she dreads her time wasted. But when she meets the victim’s equally-stubborn single father, Erik, the principal demands they give their kids the attention they deserve – by teaming up to stage

credits.title: Boundaries
credits.overview: Single mom Laura, along with her awkward 14 year-old son Henry is forced to drive Jack, her estranged, care-free pot dealing father across country after he's kicked out of yet another nursing home.

credits.title: Rufus 2
credits.overview: Rufus is a dog but turns into a human with a pendant. He meets a girl named Kat who asks him to go out. Kat is a cat who can also turn into a human as well.

credits.title: No Reservations
credits.overview: "No Reservations" is social commentary inspired by true-life events, giving a hypothetical look at what life would be like if the roles in Standing Rock were reversed. Protests erupt as an upper-middle class Caucasian neighborhood attempts to thwart the construction of a pipeline from an Indigenous Corporation.

credits.title: Garbage Man
credits.overview: An unhappy sanitation worker must face his worst fear after a curse from a raccoon turns him into a literal garbage man.
